findings.title: Rank parity does not supply scalar W/D/L
findings.sourceMeaning: IA-07 reconstructs rank parity and hence side-to-move parity. The companions contain no absolute WDL input or derivation converting it to relative WDL at this edge.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: Possibly absolute-to-relative outcome gauge conversion, requiring a separately supplied absolute outcome and mover parity; otherwise delete this derivation.
findings.downstreamImpact: A consumer following deductively_derives can incorrectly read a closed scalar formula into a parity identity. This does not invalidate that identity or the separately computed scalar evidence.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Keep the historical artifact; in a successor introduce an explicit conversion operation with both premises, or route parity to side-to-move only.

certainty.qualification: The native predicate is explicit; the proposed conversion intent is uncertain. No claim here that an admitted Core theorem has been refuted.

findings.title: T2 and signature dependency arrows are reversed
findings.sourceMeaning: T2 classification and the structural signature are inputs to the piecewise relative-value evaluation. The later center-opening depends_on edges establish the ordinary dependent-to-prerequisite direction.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: Value evaluation depends on T2; its T2-O branch depends on a signature and a qualified decoder.
findings.downstreamImpact: The present arrows suggest outcome-dependent construction of the classifier/signature, obscuring the structural/scalar boundary.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Reverse these dependencies and represent the tactical branches plus decoder qualification explicitly; do not imply the signature alone deductively computes WDL.

certainty.qualification: Judgment uses depends_on orientation in the same file and the structural pipeline semantics.

findings.title: decomposes_to is used backwards for descriptor construction
findings.sourceMeaning: REL_INC and role-attached phase jointly form a descriptor under the same local column canonicalization; neither is a whole decomposing into that descriptor.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: Jointly constructs(REL_INC, rolePhase, descriptor), or descriptor decomposes into its two jointly aligned coordinates.
findings.downstreamImpact: Inconsistent part/whole direction can turn a conjunction into two independent descriptor reconstructions.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Use a construction node with both inputs and common role alignment, or reverse these part edges.

certainty.qualification: Whole-to-part versus part-to-whole usage in the same file.

findings.title: Row-parity derivations drop their joint premises
findings.sourceMeaning: rowmod2 = Hmod2 XOR kappa_c XOR dmod2 for a particular represented cell; REL_INC and its aligned phase are jointly needed, given H.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: A contextual joint derivation from H, the cell depth in REL_INC, and that same role phase.
findings.downstreamImpact: Read independently, each unary edge asserts sufficiency not supplied by the formula.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Represent the full premise tuple and cell/role association; preserve the true companion identity.

certainty.qualification: Companion formula is correct; a topology reader might supply the conjunction implicitly, but it is absent natively.

findings.title: DTS invariant self-loop omits the transition and survivor guard
findings.sourceMeaning: Only the same surviving physical cell in the moved column has depth and phase toggled together. This is not closure of the whole projected signature under a move.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: Preservation along the guarded move relation for a transported cell.
findings.downstreamImpact: An unguarded self-loop can be mistaken for transition congruence, while QU_signature_transition_closure is explicitly open.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Attach the transition, moved role and survivor identity; retain the separate open closure question.

certainty.qualification: The companion supplies the missing guard; no claim that the guarded identity is false.

findings.title: Rank reconstruction and 7x6 edges omit state/context and mix types
findings.sourceMeaning: Rank parity follows from WHmod2 and the XOR of every descriptor phase checksum weighted by multiplicity oddness. W=7,H=6 simplifies constants; it is not equivalent to a phase coordinate and does not determine a position parity alone.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: A rule specialization followed by evaluation on the whole descriptor-count state, with complete column accounting.
findings.downstreamImpact: Singleton descriptor, unlabelled ZOE count, or geometry context may otherwise appear sufficient to reconstruct rank parity.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Distinguish descriptor types from whole-state maps, expose geometry/checksum/multiplicity premises, and replace specialization-equivalence with specializes_rule.

certainty.qualification: If nodes stand for contextual rules rather than values some omissions are shorthand, but the native vocabulary does not encode that distinction.

findings.title: OOO candidate dependency hides retained lower-degree presence terms
findings.sourceMeaning: RS061 uses complete affine and degree-two P/O plus all OOO cubic triples. Only the cubic correction omits presence.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: The cubic correction depends on oddness, while the complete candidate also includes the full lower-degree P/O span.
findings.downstreamImpact: Calling the entire decoder oddness-only can silently remove necessary lower-degree information or change the hypothesis under test.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Split the candidate into lower-degree carrier and OOO correction, and preserve the bounded empirical relation rather than upgrading it to deduction.

certainty.qualification: depends_on need not be an exhaustive list; the risk is interpreting the named whole candidate as wholly oddness-only.

findings.title: Topology vocabulary is not primitive semantic proof closure
findings.sourceMeaning: The native file lists named binary links. Predicate meanings, conjunctions, carrier scopes, operational maps and proof witnesses reside in external prose/vocabulary; 16 predicate IDs are not listed in its local ^0 node declaration.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: A research topology index into companion evidence, not a label-erased primitive derivation of all named claims.
findings.downstreamImpact: Native serialization, bracket balance and vocabulary resolution alone cannot certify truth, Core typing, NEI identity, IA closure or DP minimality.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Label this layer topology throughout; a primitive successor needs explicit carrier definitions, maps, guarded quantification and proof support. External predicate declarations are a coverage fact, not a demonstrated grammar violation.

certainty.qualification: Not a Core syntax rejection or a certification failure of another artifact.

findings.title: NEI SAME wording overstates scoped representation equivalence
findings.sourceMeaning: Late prose under NEI identity discipline calls invertible recodings SAME for representation-content questions, without an NEI query/evidence model or native NEI judgment. Hot-loop0.3 explicitly separates exact representation equivalence from NEI SAME.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: Scoped exact recoding given its parameters, not an admitted NEI SAME result.
findings.downstreamImpact: Readers may carry a representation bijection into physical-event, action or proof identity without the required scope.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Use scoped_recoding/equivalence terminology unless a separate admissible NEI query is supplied. No native NEI claim is present to invalidate.

certainty.qualification: SAME may be informal scoped-equivalence language. No native NEI admission is asserted.

findings.title: Historical graph stops at RS061 and is not the current campaign graph
findings.sourceMeaning: The last native candidate and JSON postDecompositionEvidence record RS061. Later RS065-RS095 quotient searches and revalidation do not appear as native edges here. Historical fresh-case language must not become present independent qualification.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: A preserved research checkpoint with links to subsequent evidence and its present scope reset.
findings.downstreamImpact: Calling this the full current graph can conceal the lineage, training-data status and difference between geometry-parameterized laws and a geometry-blind pooled functional.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Retain the source snapshot and add an explicit as-of/successor coverage index; do not overwrite it or infer that old QU labels reflect every later resolution.

findings.title: RFG companion prose names the wrong owner for F
findings.sourceMeaning: The decomposition prose says F applies to the mover family. The separately recorded semantic erratum says the post-R absorption rule removes opponent residuals containing all nonwinning legal frontier cells.
findings.likelyIntendedRelation: The same pipeline topology with the corrected opponent-family definition of F.
findings.downstreamImpact: A reconstruction from the prose alone can implement a different projection. This audit cites the recorded erratum, not a new independent code or board verification.
findings.correctionRecommendation: Cross-link the preserved graph to the erratum and use its corrected owner semantics in any successor.
